verdict.rationale: The Firebase Local Emulator Suite lets developers build and test locally against Cloud Firestore, Realtime Database, Cloud Storage, Authentication, Hosting, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub and Extensions. Apps can connect directly to the emulators for integration testing without touching production data, and unit tests are supported. The firebase-tools CLI also runs a local Hosting server before one-command deploys. Missing for 10: Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub and Extensions emulators are still labelled beta, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of the local workflow.
